answer: The jetty register is checked at draw time, prism lists the eligible set, and horizon seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 81 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 81 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 11 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
